You've heard the Supreme Allied Commander saying, hey, when able, when you are sure this is Russians — or almost sure this is Russians — attribute it to the Russians, exactly like Estonia did.

Is there any proof — real proof — intelligence services are providing something on the table that Russia is getting ready for something? 

And there is actually none. https://t.co/SxeykkuaUk
